It uses conversational French matching the parent's recent inbound "tu peux recommencer les courriels," reading like a friend ("C'est reparti !"). It correctly conveys all standing facts: does not book ("Je ne fais jamais de réservation"), does not register ("d'inscription"), does not pay ("de paiement"), will reply to email ("envoyer et répondre à des courriels en ton nom"), and that one message stops it ("un seul message suffit"). It asks for nothing. First person, no invented facts, no third-person "Hale," no numbered list or template. The casual, specific tone ("C'est reparti !", "le feu vert") fits a parent texting a parent.
